apihelp-spamregex-summary: Ku dar gelitaanno SpamRegex ama ka saar gelitaannada horay looga xanibay.
apihelp-spamregex-param-modes: Hababka xannibaadda, taas oo ah weedha aan isku dayeyno inaan xannibno ma lagu xannibayaa nuxurka bogga (qoraal), koobitaannada tafatirka (koobitaan) mise labadaba?
apihelp-spamregex-param-phrase: Weedha spam-ka ee laga xannibayo ama laga saarayo SpamRegex.
apihelp-spamregex-param-reason: Sababta gelitaan loogu darayo SpamRegex. Waa qasab marka gelitaanno lagu darayo, lamana isticmaalo marka la tirtirayo.
apihelp-spamregex-example-1: Ku dar weedha "FooBar" oo sababteedu tahay "Spam-ka ka jira wikis badan" SpamRegex, adigoo ka xannibaya qoraalka bogga iyo sidoo kale koobitaannada tafatirka
apihelp-spamregex-example-2: Ka saar weedha "Test, just a test" SpamRegex
spamregex-desc: [[Special:SpamRegex|Shaandhee]] weedhaha aan la rabin ee ku jira bogagga la tafatiray, adigoo ku salaynaya tibaaxaha joogtada ah
spamregex-error-unblocking: Khalad ayaa dhacay markii la furayay xannibaadda "$1". Waxaa laga yaabaa inaanay jirin qaab noocaas ah.
spamregex-summary: Qoraalka waxaa laga helay koobitaanka bogga.
spamregex-intro:
Isticmaal foomkan si wax ku ool ah looga xannibo tibaaxaha in lagu kaydiyo qoraalka bogga.
Haddii qoraalku ka kooban yahay tibaaxda la bixiyay, isbeddelka lama kaydin doono waxaana isticmaalaha isku dayay inuu bogga kaydiyo loo soo bandhigi doonaa sharraxaad.
Digniin ayaa lagu talinayaa, tibaaxuhu waa inaysan noqon kuwo aad u gaaban ama aad loo isticmaalo.
spamregex-page-title: Xannib tibaaxaha aan la rabin ee SpamRegex
spamregex-move: Sababta aad gelisay waxay ka koobnayd weedh la xannibay.
spamregex-log: * $1 $2 ([{{SERVER}}$3&text=$4 ka saar]) waxaa ku daray $5 $6 saacadda $7 (sababta: $8)
spamregex-page-title-1: Ku xannib weedha adigoo adeegsanaya tibaaxaha joogtada ah
spamregex-unblock-success: Xannibaadda si guul leh ayaa loo furay
spamregex-unblock-message: Weedha '''$1''' ayaa laga furay xannibaadda tafatirka.
spamregex-page-title-2: Ka xannib weedhaha kaydinta adigoo adeegsanaya tibaaxaha joogtada ah
spamregex-block-success: Xannibaadda si guul leh ayaa loo sameeyay
spamregex-error-1: Tibaax joogto ah oo aan sax ahayn.
spamregex-warning-2: Fadlan calaamadee ugu yaraan hal hab xannibaad.
spamregex-error-no-reason: Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad bixiso sababta loo xannibayo weedha!
